notes.title: The Red Strings Club Makes Its Physical Debut!
notes.content:
Special Reserve Games has teamed up with Deconstructeam and Devolver Digital to create the ultimate physical collector's edition of THE RED STRINGS CLUB! 

Limited to a run of 3,000 copies, for true fans and collectors, this special physical edition is [url=https://specialreservegames.com/the-red-strings-club-switch-reserve/]ON SALE NOW![/url] (while supplies last)

The Special Reserve Games physical edition of THE RED STRINGS CLUB for Nintendo Switch features:
[list]
[*] [b]SWITCH CARTRIDGE[/b]
Includes critical updates, patches, and DLC
Packaged inside the Switch game case
[*] [b]SHIPS IN A SPECIAL RESERVE BOX[/b]
Multiple textures and processes
Makes a great shelf display and protects your game!
[*] [b]SEQUENTIALLY NUMBERED GAME PACKAGING[/b]
[*] [b]REVERSIBLE JACKET ARTWORK[/b]
[*] [b]32-PAGE INSTRUCTION BOOKLET[/b]
Inside the shrink-wrapped game packaging
[*] [b]TWO BAR COASTERS[/b]
Colorful PVC soft rubber
[*] 3.5" in diameter
[*] [b]5" x 7" ART CARD[/b]
Printed on thick linen paper
Watercolor-style portrait
[/list]
[url=https://specialreservegames.com/the-red-strings-club-switch-reserve/]On sale now! While Supplies Last[/url]
